title: Summer 2027 | UI Motion Artist Intern
note: UI motion and VFX for Nex Playground motion games, built in Unity; portfolio or demo reel required.

facts.duties: Create UI animations, screen transitions, button interactions and VFX for games and fitness experiences; prototype and implement motion in Unity; work with UI/UX designers and artists.
facts.requirements: Current undergraduate or graduate student; strong motion fundamentals (timing, easing); After Effects, Photoshop and Illustrator a plus; basic Unity familiarity; portfolio or reel.
facts.apply: Apply on Nex's Greenhouse job board.
